# btpservice_ctms_destination (Data Source)

Reads an existing transport destination. CTMS does not manage destination credentials through this API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "btpservice_ctms_destination" "example" {
  name              = "QUALITY_CF"
  include_tenant_id = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact destination name.

### Optional

- `include_tenant_id` (Boolean) Request the destination tenant ID. Defaults to false when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `application` (String) Application, if returned.
- `data_center` (String) Data center, if returned.
- `description` (String) Destination description, if returned.
- `platform_types` (List of String) Platform types in API order.
- `tenant_id` (String) Destination tenant ID, if requested and returned. This is not the CTMS provider's subaccount scope.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) Destination URL. Redacted because URLs may contain credentials; sensitive output is still stored in state.
